decisions.reason: Intermittent operation applies to the switched 5V sensor rail and does not change the ESP32's established sleep modes, wake sources, intervals, or deep-sleep policy.
The 5V rail's intermittent operation does not change the requirement for an NTC contact on the battery connector.
The source decision changes only the operating pattern of the switched 5V sensor rail; it does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or thermal protection requirements.
Intermittent use of the switched 5V sensor rail does not change the Power Board's TVS ESD protection requirement.
